Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Capacity uplift + tenant isolation at renewal - Q3 rollout

Hi Jonas,

We're coming up on our annual contract renewal and the product team wants to accelerate a private deployment for a set of sensitive workloads. High level asks: add two dedicated VPC environments (one for analytics, one for clinical), isolate 3 tenants into their own clusters, and guarantee baseline throughput of ~1,200 rps across the analytics environment.

Could we get a mutual action plan (MAP) and a rough lead time estimate for provisioning? We are also evaluating a term change — shifting to a 24-month committed term in exchange for staged capacity discounts. Procurement cc'd on this thread.

Thanks,
Ariela Sanchez
Head of Platform Operations
HealthMetric Labs

Hi Ariela — thanks for the clear ask and the workbook. Congrats on the push to private for the sensitive workloads; we have a good playbook here.

Next steps I propose:
- I'll assemble a MAP that splits workstreams into procurement, infra provisioning, and ops runbook (including cutover windows and rollback criteria).
- Prio question: are the three tenants currently on a shared cluster today or already segmented at application level? That affects the data migration steps.
- For baseline throughput, we usually map 1,200 rps to a two-cluster analytics footprint behind autoscaling with 48-hour warm-up. I'll include options for a hot standby and an SLA uplift if you need stricter latency targets.

Can procurement confirm target go-live window? We're seeing Q3 dates on your deck.

I'll send a draft MAP by Wednesday EOD. Attaching our provisioning appendix for reference.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: sizing and lead times for HM uplift

Jonas — quick internal note before I draft the MAP:
- Tenant carveouts: if data shuttle is required (no shared DB tenancy to separate), estimate 6-8 weeks per tenant for a live migration with zero-downtime tooling; 3-4 weeks if customers accept a short maintenance window.
- Analytics clusters: to support sustained 1,200 rps we recommend 3x A100-equivalent instances with 2x hot standby nodes for failover; procurement pricing for 24-month commitment can drop unit price ~18-22% depending on burst reserves.
- Network isolation / VPC peering and cross-account routing: allow 2 weeks for infra, 1 week for security approvals (SOC evidence).

Kimberly — can you start a SOC2 evidence pull and give me the retention/export window? Marcus — team availability for a staged rollout in July/Aug?

— Priyom

Ariela / Procurement — attaching the initial MAP (HealthMetric_MAP_v3.xlsx) and the provisioning appendix. Highlights:
- Milestones: NDA addendum & SOW sign (by 05-May), infra provisioning (06-May to 23-Jun), tenant migrations (phased: Tenant A short window 20-Jun, Tenant B live migration 04-Jul, Tenant C verification 18-Jul), staging & performance tests (25-Jul to 08-Aug), production cutover window week of 29-Aug.
- Pricing: 24-month committed term with 20% standard discount and an additional 5% for two-stage upfront commit; options for burst reserve blocks outlined in MAP.
- Operational asks: SOC2 evidence NDA, access window for schema export, and a single technical point-of-contact on HealthMetric side for migration day.
- Owners: Redwood infra (Priyom), Security (Kimberly), Customer success (Marcus) — owners listed in the MAP.

Please reply with any redlines. If procurement signs the SOW by 05-May, we confirm the provisioning start date and lock the September go-live.

Thanks — Jonas
